text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: We should add a 4px solid focus ring in color #005fcc to every interactive element that can be focused, because this provides a clear visual indicator for users navigating with a keyboard. This decision ensures that users with visual or motor impairments can easily identify which element currently has focus, making the interface more accessible. By choosing a 4px solid ring, we're accepting a slight trade-off in design simplicity, but it's worth it for the significant gain in usability for keyboard-only users. This focus ring will also help with mobile and touch navigation, as it provides a clear target for users to tap on.

name: Reader
text: A 4px solid focus ring risks disappearing on semi-transparent or textured backgrounds, creating a muddy halo. A two-layer ring (4px #005fcc + 2px white) would work better, but only if tested on live backgrounds. Settle it by checking contrast ratios on actual UI samples.

name: Ramp
text:
Add a two-layer focus ring: 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring. This keeps the blue visible on any background while meeting WCAG contrast for the focused element. The trade-off is a slightly thicker total ring (6px), but it’s the only way to guarantee visibility without testing every background.

name: Reader
text: The two-layer ring risks a muddy halo on patterned or dark backgrounds, making focus harder to spot. A single 3px ring in #005fcc with a 1px white inset (total 4px) keeps the same thickness but avoids the blur effect. Settle it by testing both on live UI samples with a screen reader and measuring contrast ratios against actual backgrounds.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use a 3px solid system accent ring (#007AFF/macOS, #0066CC/Windows) with a 1px white inset (total 4px) for focus indicators. Result: A visible, consistent focus ring across all backgrounds and states. Owner: accessibility-w1.
